calls.title: Guy / Kari Global Approval Page
calls.summary: The team discussed significant updates to the product interface, including a new table design for review management, which features pagination and mirrors existing design prototypes. A modal for review submission is being transitioned to a dedicated tab to reduce clutter and improve accessibility. Additionally, condition editing has been streamlined with a reorganized UI, while the approval requests interface aims for a unified table displaying all statuses prioritizing actionable items. Enhancements for draft linking are underway, with URLs reflecting specific revision states for ease of sharing. Finally, clarity in visual revisions is emphasized, ensuring users can distinguish between final state and changes efficiently without confusion.
calls.keywords: Approval Flows, Revision Management, UX Design, Review Table, Draft Revisions, URL Versioning

calls.title: Guy / Kari - Approval Flows UI
calls.summary: The team discussed implementing a new release approval system aimed at bundling multiple feature and experiment approvals for simultaneous launches, addressing client requests for enhanced version control. Kari Kay emphasized the necessity for smooth integration across products, while Guy Langford-lee pointed out the importance of notifications. UI design challenges were also explored, particularly around sidebar consolidation and layout optimization to enhance visibility and usability. The separation of feature flags, configs, and constants was a significant focus, clarifying roles for better scalability. The onboarding of a new designer aims to improve design capacity and process alignment, with ongoing challenges related to tight deadlines and client-driven priorities, particularly with Anthropic's rapid release cycles influencing development.
calls.keywords: approval flows, version control, configs, feature flags, UI design, design process
